mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_user_report ( user_id, report_date, login_times, register_state, recharge_times, recharge_amt, activate_state, first_recharge_state, first_recharge_amt, placeorder_times, order_amt, order_result_amt, user_cash_out_amt, user_cash_out_times, agent_cash_out_amt, agent_cash_out_times) SELECT p.user_id AS user_id, IFNULL( p.proc_date, 0 ) , -- 日期 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 0 ),0),-- 登录次数 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 1 ),0),-- 注册状态 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 2 ),0),-- 充值次数 IFNULL(sum( IF ( p.proc_type = 2, p.proc_value, 0 ) ),0),-- 充值金额 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 5 ),0),-- 激活状态 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 3 ),0),-- 首充状态 IFNULL(sum( IF ( p.proc_type = 3, p.proc_value, 0 ) ),0),-- 首充金额 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 4 ),0),-- 下单单数 IFNULL(sum( IF ( p.proc_type = 4, p.proc_value, 0 ) ),0),-- 下单金额 IFNULL(sum( IF ( p.proc_type = 4, p.order_result_amt, 0 ) ),0),-- 下单结果金额 IFNULL(sum( IF ( p.proc_type = 6, p.proc_value, 0 ) ),0),-- 用户提现金额 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 6 ),0),-- 用户提现次数 IFNULL(sum( IF ( p.proc_type = 7, p.proc_value, 0 ) ),0),-- 代理提现金额 IFNULL(sum( p.proc_type = 7 ),0)-- 代理提现次数 FROM p_user_proc p INNER JOIN s_user u ON p.user_id = u.id AND u.user_type != 1 WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{sProcId} AND #{eProcId} GROUP BY p.user_id, p.proc_date ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_times = login_times + VALUES(login_times), register_state = register_state + VALUES(register_state), recharge_times = recharge_times + VALUES(recharge_times), recharge_amt = recharge_amt + VALUES(recharge_amt), activate_state = activate_state + VALUES(activate_state), first_recharge_state = first_recharge_state + VALUES(first_recharge_state), first_recharge_amt = first_recharge_amt + VALUES(first_recharge_amt), placeorder_times = placeorder_times + VALUES(placeorder_times), order_amt = IFNULL(order_amt,0) + VALUES(order_amt), order_result_amt = IFNULL(order_result_amt,0) + VALUES(order_result_amt), user_cash_out_amt = user_cash_out_amt + VALUES(user_cash_out_amt), user_cash_out_times = user_cash_out_times + VALUES(user_cash_out_times), agent_cash_out_amt = agent_cash_out_amt + VALUES(agent_cash_out_amt), agent_cash_out_times = agent_cash_out_times + VALUES(agent_cash_out_times)
